explanation: Matches recurrence (2) of arXiv:2607.05739, x_n=(x_{n-1}+n)/(1-n x_{n-1}), reindexed to n+1 for n≥1. The x_1=1 part of the docstring is omitted from the statement but is trivial. No division-by-zero problem: A_n≠0 for all n (Z_n mod 3 is ±1 or ±(1+i)), and a vanishing denominator would mean A_{n+1}=0.
